In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a '''camp''' was set up by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]] and his charges in the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]] on a [[Unidentified jungle moon (K'Kruhk)|jungle moon]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was based around a crashed [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]<ref name="DT 7" /> located on the banks of a river.<ref name="DT 8">[[Dark Times 8|''Dark Times'' 8]]</ref>

The camp was raided by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Lumbra]], who had also crashed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]],<ref name="DT 9">[[Dark Times 9|''Dark Times'' 9]]</ref> leading the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to abandon the camp and use [[Lumbra's ship]] to escape the moon.<ref name="DT 10">[[Dark Times 10|''Dark Times'' 10]]</ref>
